trigger: Avila's command post. Federal orders versus the governor.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Avila's command post. Two radios: one federal, one state. Both are talking. She's not answering either.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: The governor orders me to resist the Directive. Fort Irwin orders me to assist Ironwood. Both are legal.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: Tonight Ironwood moves a Bradley through the rail trench to take the Floor's warehouses. I have to pick.

choices.text: Break with them. Protect your city.
Stay with the chain of command.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: The real one? Thirty-one days. If the warehouses go west, it's nine.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: ...Fine. Fine. Nine days is murder with paperwork.

choices.text: Then follow orders. Live with it.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: God help me. Okay. The Guard holds the bridges. The Army holds everything else. Get to the trench.

nodes.speaker: avila
nodes.text: Thank you. It's the only order I know how to give. Stay out of the trench tonight, Pearce.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Downtown, the Bradley's engine echoes off dead casinos.
